about: Our own real-game recordings for the whole-game levels C and D (python -m simbench recordings). Each was recorded from the real game (an RLBot match, Steam edition, 31 October to 4 November 2026) and holds only what a replay needs: the first kickoff's start, every frame's physics steps, duration, render alpha and controls, the level's spot choices or random-stream start, and the packet rows the score compares.
release: the files marked 'release' are in the release archive catsim-recordings-v1.tar (unpack it and point SIMBENCH_RECORDINGS at the folder); 'git' ones are in this folder
game_data: replay them with game data from catsim-dump on Steam build 26349479 (6 November 2026) or one with the same tables: the dump of build 25914621 holds Darkcar (Batmobile) values a float step or two off from the ones these games ran on, and the recordings with a Darkcar body drift with it
